incident-bot: PAGER — HIGH severity: inferpool-us-west-2 NotReady spike: ~30 nodes reporting NotReady. Pager sent to @sam. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inferpool-notready
sam: I'm on it, grabbing node list and kubelet logs
sasha: seeing a small customer impact spike: 5xx rate up ~2.3% for hosted endpoints in us-west, latency +120ms
sam: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=infer-usw -o wide | grep NotReady` shows 29 NotReady, many with REASON="KubeletNotReady"
sam: journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 on infer-node-23 shows repeated restarts and this snippet:
```
Mar 15 02:14:05 infer-node-23 kubelet[1234]: E0315 02:14:05 kubelet.go:200] node status: Kubelet stopped posting status
Mar 15 02:14:06 infer-node-23 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31
Mar 15 02:14:06 infer-node-23 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```
sasha: Xid 31 indicates possible GPU driver crash / OOM on GPU
lia: routing: I can enable fallback routing to eu-west replica set for high-risk customers and pin critical routes to dedicated capacity
sam: action plan: 1) cordon + drain 3 most noisy nodes, 2) restart kubelet on a few nodes, 3) escalate to infra to check GPU drivers and kernel OOM settings, 4) temporarily raise dedicated pool min nodes
maria: customer impact: two enterprise customers opened high priority tickets mentioning timeouts; support already acknowledged and noted S2
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 created, severity=S2, owner=@sam, channel=#eng-oncall
sam: cordoned infer-node-23/45/67 and started drains; `systemctl restart kubelet` on 23 returned kubelet up but containerd OOMd on some pods
ben: infra here. we see a pattern of NVRM Xid 31 on that GPU SKU after recent driver upgrade. We'll roll driver to previous stable on the affected nodegroup. Scheduling reprovision/rolling update now.
lia: enabled route fallback and set model-variant-fallback to quantized for a subset of traffic to reduce GPU memory pressure
sam: NotReady count down to 8 now, error rate dropping to 0.6%, latency trending down. Will keep rolling restarts in small batches.
maria: drafting customer note: ETA 30-45m for full recovery, will update in 20m. Any objections? :thumbsup:
ben: rolling update started for nodegroup infer-usw-gpu-a, will update 10 nodes at a time
sam: leaving handoff notes for nightshift: restarted kubelet on nodes 23, 45, 67; infra rolling driver; routing fallback enabled; monitoring shows improving metrics
ryan: taking post-handoff watch, ack. I'll follow up with infra and mark when all nodes back to Ready
incident-bot: Pager resolved for INC-2026-211 — auto-resolve at 1758001290
sam: thanks everyone, will file a postmortem once driver roll completes and we validate patch
maria: noted, I'll prep initial impact summary for customers
